name: Jaina Proudmoore
summary: On Theramore Isle, Jaina Proudmoore works to preserve peace between the Alliance and the New Horde. Once a gifted student of Dalaran’s Kirin Tor, she led Lordaeron’s survivors across the Great Sea and now rules the island as its most powerful human sorceress.

sections.title: Flight to Kalimdor
sections.body:
Jaina Proudmoore, daughter of Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore of Kul Tiras, showed an early gift for magic. In Dalaran, she studied under Archmage Antonidas. During the Third War, she investigated the Plague of Undeath with Prince Arthas Menethil and witnessed Lordaeron’s fall.

Then the Prophet Medivh warned her of the coming danger, and she gathered human survivors to sail west for Kalimdor. There, Jaina’s forces joined Thrall’s Horde and the night elves. Together they stood at Mount Hyjal, defeated Archimonde, and broke the Burning Legion’s invasion.

sections.title: The Lady of Theramore
sections.body:
After the Legion’s defeat, Jaina founded Theramore, an island citadel off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh. It became the Alliance’s main stronghold in southern Kalimdor. Her commitment to peace faced its greatest test when her father came seeking vengeance against the orcs.

Jaina would not join his war. She stood aside as Thrall’s forces killed the Grand Admiral, preventing another devastating conflict in Kalimdor. Now Jaina rules Theramore and speaks for coexistence. She works closely with Warchief Thrall while holding the Alliance’s ground amid rising local tensions.

faq.answer: Jaina rules Theramore Isle and is considered the most gifted living human mage. She is the daughter of Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore of Kul Tiras and studied under Archmage Antonidas in Dalaran.

faq.q: Why is Jaina in Kalimdor instead of the Eastern Kingdoms?
faq.answer: Before Lordaeron fell in the Third War, the Prophet Medivh warned Jaina to lead as many people as she could across the sea to Kalimdor. Her expedition survived the voyage, fought at Mount Hyjal, and settled in Theramore, a port-fortress in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: What is Jaina's relationship with the Horde?
faq.answer: Jaina and Warchief Thrall share a cautious friendship. They fought together against the Burning Legion at Mount Hyjal and have worked to keep peace between their peoples, despite fierce opposition from hardliners on both sides.

faq.q: What happened between Jaina and Prince Arthas Menethil?
faq.answer: Jaina and Arthas were close companions and shared a romance. They investigated the plague spreading across Lordaeron together, but Jaina was horrified as Arthas grew ruthless. At Stratholme, she refused to join him in slaughtering infected citizens.

angles.text: Jaina trained under Archmage Antonidas and is widely considered the most powerful living human sorceress. Her skill reflects the heights of Dalaran’s arcane mastery.

As an Alliance member, you have a vital foothold in southern Kalimdor through Jaina. She balances loyalty to Highlord Bolvar’s regency in Stormwind with her wish to avoid war with the neighboring Horde.
